vibeRadar.peekDesc: Privacy is earned through chemistry. Faces unblur automatically when reaching Level 4 Chemistry.
vibeRadar.faq1Q: Is SECCION really 100% free for members?
vibeRadar.faq1A: Yes. All matchmaking, communication channels, compatibility radar checks, and our Dating Coach assistant are free. Unlike other platforms that lock visibility behind monthly fees because they have too many profiles of one gender, SECCION is funded by our creator monetization layers. This means we value you as a partner in connection, not as a customer to be billed.
vibeRadar.faq2Q: How does the Synergy matching engine connect me with matches?
vibeRadar.faq2A: Instead of just sorting by proximity or photos, our engine reads your personal style, vibe preferences, and current mood to suggest matches. It provides a simple, direct explanation of why a match fits your vibe, skipping boring spreadsheets and formulas to focus on real compatibility.
vibeRadar.faq3Q: How does the Chemistry Meter work?
vibeRadar.faq3A: The Chemistry Meter is our progress gauge. It tracks mutual chat momentum and activity, scaling from Level 1 (Undefined) up to Level 8 (Soulmate). As your Vibe Level increases, the platform unlocks new features, real-world date templates, and deeper sharing capabilities automatically.
vibeRadar.faq4Q: How does the Reveal Progression protect privacy while keeping dating attractive?
vibeRadar.faq4A: Profiles feature two clear, unblurred 'Aesthetic Anchors' (lifestyle shots, silhouette, or fashion vibes) so you can feel a partner's style. The main portrait stays blurred or visible based on privacy settings. You can request a 5-minute 'Limited Peek' or receive an 'Unblur Key' (24-hour clear view pass) directly from your match to reveal details.
vibeRadar.faq5Q: What are Sponsored Creators and VIP Subscriptions?
vibeRadar.faq5A: Sponsored Creators are creators you choose to support directly. A single VIP Subscription connects you with up to 10 chosen creators from your list, unlocking their exclusive workspaces, channels, and streams. This gives you high-fidelity content and close matches in one simple monthly bundle.
vibeRadar.faq6Q: Can a Member upgrade to a Creator account?
vibeRadar.faq6A: Yes. To prevent spam and maintain a verified community, you must sign up for a Member account first. Once your member account is active, you can easily go to your Account Settings to apply for a Creator Upgrade, verify your external channels, and unlock the Creator Studio dashboard.
vibeRadar.faq7Q: Are Date Plans free to create and browse?
vibeRadar.faq7A: Yes. Members can create one customized Date Plan (a concrete, time-bound date proposal) per month for free, and you get unlimited applications to apply to dates posted by other members or creators. Confirming a date boosts your Chemistry Meter, helping you skip situationship limbo and meet in person.
vibeRadar.faq8Q: How does the Dating Coach AI help me connect?
vibeRadar.faq8A: Our built-in AI Wingman acts as a digital relationship coach and platform assistant. It reads chat flow momentum (Connection Gravity), suggests warm icebreakers, and highlights the best moments to invite a partner on a coffee date based on their lifestyle archetypes.
vibeRadar.faq9Q: How does SECCION verify profile safety without storing my ID documents?
vibeRadar.faq9A: To unlock real-world dating moves (Level 4+), users complete a secure face verification and liveness check to confirm they match their profile photos. To respect your privacy, SECCION does not store any official identity documents. Once the check succeeds, all ID media is permanently deleted.
vibeRadar.faq10Q: Can I connect and talk with matches in other countries?
vibeRadar.faq10A: Absolutely. Our platform is built for global vibes (matching US, UK, EU, and South America). Our Live Translation gateway automatically translates text and voice messages in real-time, allowing you to speak and listen in your native languages seamlessly.
vibeRadar.ctaDesc: Step into a premium, transparent dating landscape funded by the creator economy. Join SECCION today and unlock free premium matchmaking.

provenance.title: Content Provenance Declaration
provenance.subtitle: Select how this content was created. Your audience will see this label. Be transparent — it builds trust.
provenance.genuineDesc: This content was created entirely by the creator without any AI generation tools. Photos are taken by camera, videos are recorded live, and text is written by the creator personally.
provenance.genuineExamples: Selfies, filmed videos, handwritten captions, live recordings
provenance.aiAssistedDesc: The core content was created by the creator, but AI tools were used to enhance it. This includes AI-powered filters, background removal, auto-captioning, color grading, or grammar correction.
provenance.aiAssistedExamples: Photos with AI filters, AI-captioned videos, AI-corrected text, auto-enhanced lighting
provenance.aiGeneratedShort: Fully generated by the creator's Replicant
provenance.aiGeneratedDesc: This content was entirely generated by AI on behalf of the creator. The creator authorized their Replicant to produce this using their trained voice, style, and likeness.
provenance.aiGeneratedExamples: AI-generated images, Replicant-written messages, AI voice recordings, synthetic avatars
provenance.aiEnhancedDesc: The creator started with real, original content but used AI to significantly modify it beyond simple filters. This includes AI face-tuning, body modification, AI background replacement, or AI-powered video editing.
provenance.aiEnhancedExamples: AI face-tuned photos, AI background swaps, AI video effects, deepfake-style modifications
provenance.autoDetectionNotice: SECCION automatically analyzes uploaded content to verify provenance. If our analysis differs from your declaration, we'll ask you to reconsider.
provenance.requiresConsent: Requires active Replicant Authorization in Studio → Settings
